rulings.Case Title: CONSERVATORSHIP OF SUSAN LI
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #2, Report, Fees
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 08/19/2026. Issue necessitating continuance: If fees requested are based upon a percentage of the estate, such as one percent (1%) per annum of the fair market value of assets at the end of the accounting period, the Court may require supporting time records. In addition, the request must address the standards and criteria set forth in CRC 7.756. Please submit timesheets showing the work performed by conservator and a verified supplemental declaration that addresses the factors set forth in CRC 7.56(a). Please address the above and delivery courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 08/05/2026 to avoid additional continuance.
